toegepas.blok: Verskillende werk en dalk 'n nuwe manier van boer
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'In een nedersetting' can read as 'in one particular settlement'; 'Binne' makes clear the work was divided inside a single settlement.
toegepas.fout: 'In een nedersetting' can be read as 'in one particular settlement' (and not in others), which blurs that the paragraph is about work divided inside a single settlement.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Binne' keeps the same place and people, only makes clear that the division of work was within one settlement, and touches no protected wording.

toegepas.voor: van buite die vallei 'n nedersetting begin
toegepas.na: van buite die vallei 'n nedersetting gestig
toegepas.rede_vinder: One 'stig' a settlement in Afrikaans; 'n nedersetting begin' echoes English 'start a settlement'.
toegepas.fout: 'n nedersetting begin' copies English 'start a settlement'; Afrikaans founds a settlement with 'stig'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Gestig' is the natural, exact verb for the same action by the same people at the same time, and 'wat ons K2 noem' stays intact.

na_skrywer.blok: Verskillende werk en dalk 'n nuwe manier van boer
na_skrywer.voor: en het die manier waarop die grond bewerk is, so meer kompleks geword
na_skrywer.na: en so het die manier waarop die grond bewerk is, meer kompleks geword
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Putting 'so' first gives natural inversion and removes the wooden 'en het ... so meer kompleks geword'; the clause stays under 'Volgens party argeoloë' and the hedge is unchanged.
na_skrywer.fout: The clause 'en het die manier waarop die grond bewerk is, so meer kompleks geword' is wooden and the whole sentence is long and hard to follow for a Grade 6 reader.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but fronting 'so' turns the second clause into its own main clause and loosens its attachment to 'Volgens party argeoloe' on a contested, unproven claim, so the writer should fix the sentence (for example by splitting it) without moving the hedge.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Mense in die streek het geweet
na_skrywer.na: Mense in die streek het ook geweet
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The last sentence comes after the digging method without a link; 'ook' ties it to 'Byna alles' as the other source, without adding content.
na_skrywer.fout: The closing sentence about local people knowing Mapungubwe stands unlinked after the digging method, so the reader does not see it as the other source that 'Byna alles' leaves room for.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Adding 'ook' right after 'So weet ons' can read as the local people knowing in addition to, or after, the archaeologists, which moves the meaning; the link needs the writer's own fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Die plat land langs 'n rivier wat onder water kom
na_skrywer.na: Die plat land wat langs 'n rivier lê en onder water kom
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: In the original 'wat' can refer to 'rivier', so the river seems to go under water; the new order ties it to the land.
na_skrywer.fout: In the glossary entry 'wat onder water kom' can attach to 'rivier' instead of to 'land'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but this is a glossary definition and rewording it beyond a spelling or grammar fix belongs to the writer, for every lesson that uses the term.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Al die mense wat saam leef en met mekaar te doen het.
vlae.rede: The glossary defines 'samelewing', but the word does not appear anywhere in the lesson text; adding or removing it is a content decision, so it is flagged rather than changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Mense het hier gewoon lank voordat Mapungubwe 'n koninkryk geword het.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Lank voordat Mapungubwe 'n koninkryk geword het, het mense al hier gewoon.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The adverbial 'lank voordat...' trailing after the verb is loose spoken word order; fronting it reads as natural written Afrikaans, and 'koninkryk' is kept.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original word order reads naturally, and the proposal is a reordering that also adds 'al', which is a lateral move with an added word.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Al hoe meer mense in die vallei
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A year is written without a thousands space.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: '1 300 nC' is the curriculum's own printed form and must stay as it is.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The compound is the natural form and avoids the double 'van' with 'onder meer van diere en mense'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'baie beeldjies van klei' is fact wording still waiting for its check, it is correct Afrikaans as it stands, and the compound is only a lateral rewording.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The time phrase needs a preposition in written Afrikaans.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Omtrent dieselfde tyd' is correct Afrikaans without a preposition, and 'omtrent in dieselfde tyd' reads worse.
'baie krale van glas' is fact wording still waiting for its check and reads correctly, so the compound is only a lateral change.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: One 'skryf iets neer' on paper; 'op papier geskryf' is slightly unidiomatic.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'op papier geskryf' is natural Afrikaans, and 'neergeskryf' only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Daar is deur al hierdie jare in die vallei
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Regdeur hierdie jare is daar in die vallei
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'deur al hierdie jare' calques 'through all these years'; 'regdeur hierdie jare' is the Afrikaans form.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'deur al hierdie jare' is good Afrikaans for 'throughout these years', so the reordering to 'regdeur' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: raak vandag juis op hierdie plek aan mekaar
laat_vaar_vorige.na: grens vandag juis op hierdie plek aan mekaar
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Countries 'grens aan mekaar' in Afrikaans; 'raak aan mekaar' is wooden for borders.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original says the three countries touch at this one point, the meeting point; 'grens aan mekaar' is a general neighbour relation that loses that precision and repeats 'grens' from two sentences earlier.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'vergaan' takes the auxiliary 'het', so the two verbs need their own auxiliaries.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'vergaan is' is an accepted stative form sharing 'is' with 'weg', so this is not a plain grammar error, and a glossary definition should not be reworded on a contested point.
